method: archive bytes per base = archive object size (from --sizes) / base_count (run table); oversized when above 2
detection_limit: only the runs in the sizes table are examined; the catalog holds no archive sizes
notes: UNMEASURED: whether other runs exceed the threshold (no catalog-wide pass over archive sizes); the threshold 2.0 bytes per base is not calibrated. Owner judgement (PopSeq#49): old record, very short reads (about 76 bp per mate), exclude

method: reads of a run (first 1 Gb of bases, every Nth pair) sketched at scaled 200 and classified against the BFD reference index; the called genus and species are compared with the filed species name (PopSeq run table species_name); purity is the exact share of hashes in any genome of the filed genus
detection_limit: 7 species and 2,002 sketched SRA runs only; one index (bfd_s1000) and one read type; cutoffs min-share 0.02, mixed-purity 0.2, host-purity 0.005 are placeholders the data do not constrain; genus_only mostly reflects thin species calls in the index; a mixed or host_dominated status names a pattern, not a cause
notes: exclude_statuses from the producer's exclude_default column. Verdicts were made against the NCBI species_name of the run, before run_curation.csv; SRR34066269 is now stale by design

tool: MATPredict species_id.py (solid-k-mer containment, k=21, of a 30x subsample sketch against 18 Aspergillus genomes + Af293)
method: runs of the MATPredict A. fumigatus store with too few reads for a genome-wide call (hundreds to 136k reads per run); study titles suggest targeted sequencing registered as library_strategy WGS
detection_limit: the A. fumigatus store only (one run per BioSample); found by MATPredict and transcribed from the issue, not re-measured by PopSeq
reference: MATPredict results/2026-11-10_afum_bafA_yunnan/ on the HPCC (species_id.tsv, species_id.py); stajichlab/PopSeq#37
notes: transcribed from PopSeq#37 (54 runs of 5 studies); 53 of them are also below_1x in popseq_low_coverage, SRR33550994 is 1.016x there

tool: MATPredict species_id.py (solid-k-mer containment, k=21, of a 30x subsample sketch against 18 Aspergillus genomes + Af293)
method: runs with mean all-against-all similarity below 0.95 in the MATPredict A. fumigatus store (4,849 sketches; store median 0.995) were compared with 18 Aspergillus reference genomes plus Af293; the fraction of the run's solid k-mers in each genome is converted to an identity; mismatch = nearest reference is another species; unverified_species = no reference placed the run
detection_limit: only the 18 Aspergillus references and Af293; a species outside that set (e.g. A. hiratsukae) cannot be named; found by MATPredict and transcribed from the issue, not re-measured by PopSeq
reference: MATPredict results/2026-11-10_afum_bafA_yunnan/ on the HPCC (species_id.tsv, species_id.py); stajichlab/PopSeq#37
notes: transcribed from PopSeq#37; the runs are not relabelled (a run_curation.csv relabel is the curator's decision, spec 009); identity is in source_note

method: GmG classifies the 2M-spot typing subsample; mixed = GmG mixture flag; genus_mismatch = the selected genus is neither GmG call nor among its top hits; borderline = second genus >= 5 hashes and concentration >= 0.7, rescreened at 6M spots
detection_limit: a second genus at about 2% of pairs at 2M spots, 0.5% at 6M (spike-in, MATPredict results/2026-11-02_contam_spikein/NOTE.md); no signal for a same-genus mixture
notes: flagged runs only (ok runs not recorded); runs stay typed in MATPredict; some genus_mismatch rows are genus naming within one family (Beauveria called Cordyceps), not a wrong organism

method: depth = base_count (run table) / genome_mb (catalog/genome_sizes.csv) of the run's species_taxid; below_1x when depth < 1
detection_limit: metadata only, not the reads: base_count as the archive reports it; runs of a species with no genome size, or with no positive base_count, are not examined
notes: evaluated by PopSeq from catalog data (stajichlab/PopSeq#37); est_depth_x and the runs/panel --min-depth filter use the same ratio
